title: A Counterexample to Kaplansky's Direct-Finiteness Conjecture in Odd Characteristic
summary: We construct a counterexample to Kaplansky's direct-finiteness conjecture in odd characteristic. For one specified odd prime p , we obtain a field K of order p 4 , a finitely generated group G containing torsion, and finite sums $`a,b\in K[G]`$ with $`ab=1`$ but $`ba\ne1`$. The same elements define a cellular automaton on K G that is injective but not surjective.
family_title: A torsion-free group algebra that is not directly finite
